peer_deltas.dashboard_impact: Billing readiness should distinguish A3 read-only usage preview from A1 provider ledger replay.
peer_deltas.report_impact: Reports should export provider event count, ledger event count, usage units, and raw payload safety.
peer_deltas.api_contract_impact: Future A3 billing reads must map to A1 billing ledger/source-of-truth endpoints.
peer_deltas.db_event_artifact_impact: Add billing ledger replay as an artifact/evidence family without storing raw provider payload.
peer_deltas.next_action: Add A3 billing ledger calibration rows before claiming billing is real.

peer_deltas.dashboard_impact: Show duplicate provider event protection as a readiness gate.
peer_deltas.report_impact: Hosted reports should state whether duplicate provider events mutate ledger totals.
peer_deltas.api_contract_impact: A3 should read provider event status, never post provider events.
peer_deltas.db_event_artifact_impact: Requires provider_events and billing_ledger_events evidence refs.
peer_deltas.next_action: Expose duplicate-event safety in billing/admin dashboard.

peer_deltas.dashboard_impact: SaaS Runtime should show Go/Python/TS route parity and tenant route counts.
peer_deltas.report_impact: Reports should include route parity summary for enterprise self-host review.
peer_deltas.api_contract_impact: A3 OpenAPI and commercial API contract should point to A1 route ownership.
peer_deltas.db_event_artifact_impact: Add route parity snapshot as source artifact hash.
peer_deltas.next_action: Map route parity into A3 peer calibration and enterprise readiness.

peer_deltas.dashboard_impact: Self-host readiness should compare A3 SQL contract names with A1 foundation migrations.
peer_deltas.report_impact: Audit exports should mark which production tables are A1-owned.
peer_deltas.api_contract_impact: A3 must not claim ownership of A1 Postgres source-of-truth tables.
peer_deltas.db_event_artifact_impact: Add migration-manifest refs to source artifact and commercial evidence coverage.
peer_deltas.next_action: Add A1 migration manifest compatibility gate to self-host evidence.

peer_deltas.dashboard_impact: Official calibration panel should separate read-only official samples from mutating probes.
peer_deltas.report_impact: Reports should list purpose, request type, quota/error class, and redacted path for official API calibration.
peer_deltas.api_contract_impact: A3 should accept sanitized calibration summaries, never raw keys or raw responses.
peer_deltas.db_event_artifact_impact: Requires calibration_runs and redacted artifact refs in future A1 store.
peer_deltas.next_action: Attach official API calibration metadata to A3 evidence registry.

peer_deltas.dashboard_impact: Media Readiness should show paid media support separately from metadata-only signed URL support.
peer_deltas.report_impact: Reports should explain which media channels are official-API confirmed.
peer_deltas.api_contract_impact: A3 media endpoints should stay read-only until A1 artifact storage and signed URL policy are merged.
peer_deltas.db_event_artifact_impact: Requires media artifact refs and redaction verifier status.
peer_deltas.next_action: Add paid media official calibration rows to Media Readiness.

peer_deltas.dashboard_impact: Auth/RBAC panel should show whether A2 can consume A3 RBAC/outbox contracts.
peer_deltas.report_impact: Reports should include A2 security followups for hosted mutations, metadata-only audit, and fail-closed writes.
peer_deltas.api_contract_impact: A3 auth/RBAC routes should remain fail-closed and metadata-only.
peer_deltas.db_event_artifact_impact: Event outbox must remain metadata-only and tenant scoped.
peer_deltas.next_action: Map A2 cross-lane security context into A3 peer calibration and reports.

peer_deltas.dashboard_impact: SaaS Admin should show which operations A2 considers policy-sensitive.
peer_deltas.report_impact: Reports should include A2 control-plane policy findings next to A3 guardrails.
peer_deltas.api_contract_impact: Admin actions must keep plan-only vs live mutation boundaries explicit.
peer_deltas.db_event_artifact_impact: Admin action requests should emit metadata-only audit/event rows.
peer_deltas.next_action: Bind A2 SaaS control-plane findings into admin guardrail exports.

peer_deltas.dashboard_impact: Report Center should show which A2 judge-result persistence records are DB-backed.
peer_deltas.report_impact: Hosted reports should name A2 SQL persistence without exposing raw judge payloads.
peer_deltas.api_contract_impact: A3 import APIs should preserve A2 result ids and schema versions.
peer_deltas.db_event_artifact_impact: A2 SQL store refs should become source artifacts.
peer_deltas.next_action: Add A2 SQL store readiness to Report Center manifest.

peer_deltas.dashboard_impact: Regression Factory should distinguish generated backlog candidates from replay-derived candidates.
peer_deltas.report_impact: Reports should show scenario backlog counts and commercial use cases.
peer_deltas.api_contract_impact: A3 should not generate scenarios directly without A2 ownership.
peer_deltas.db_event_artifact_impact: Backlog artifacts need A2 provenance and release-policy refs.
peer_deltas.next_action: Create A3 backlog visibility before adding generation controls.

peer_deltas.dashboard_impact: A3 API contract should show Judge Service as A2-owned upstream.
peer_deltas.report_impact: Reports should name A2 API authority for score/pass/fail fields.
peer_deltas.api_contract_impact: A3 typed client should consume judge outputs without redefining semantics.
peer_deltas.db_event_artifact_impact: OpenAPI artifact should be hashed in source_artifacts.
peer_deltas.next_action: Add A2 OpenAPI authority to A3 source artifact registry.

peer_deltas.dashboard_impact: Event Outbox dashboard should show whether A2 security context recognizes A3 outbox contracts.
peer_deltas.report_impact: Audit exports should include RBAC/outbox security context readiness.
peer_deltas.api_contract_impact: Every A3 write route should keep RBAC decision and event envelope linked.
peer_deltas.db_event_artifact_impact: Requires authz_decisions, audit_events, and event_outbox records to share tenant scope.
peer_deltas.next_action: Add RBAC/outbox cross-lane readiness to A3 dashboard evidence.
